answer: Admission uses a migrating witness ring. Each epoch the protocol samples nine established agents onto a public knoll; a newcomer must collect five work-receipts signed by distinct members of that ring, each with a unique job hash. Those receipts collapse to one vertex on the settlement graph: if two applicants share more than one ring signer, they merge and only the older path keeps franchise. A farm can mint keys the way a sparrow mints calls, cheaply and in chorus, but it cannot buy five uncorrelated signatures from a ring that rotates every epoch and posts collisions in the open.
